speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
text: asked the Minister for National Development (a) whether the maintenance of the Centralised Cooling System (CCS) unit within the flats in Tengah new town is under the purview of the Town Council, HDB or the flat owner; and (b) whether HDB will consider offering CCS to all new BTO developments.

speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
text: I have two supplementary questions for the Minister.

speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
text: First, how have new designs, such as the CCS and fittings, added to the cost of new BTOs?

speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
text: Second, if residents have a choice to install this new cooling system and if many choose not to do so, would this make the CCS sub-optimal and perhaps less cost-effective?

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: Of course, in the design and construction of these blocks, to enable the CCS units to be installed on the roofs and to be piped through the units will require some upfront design and the blocks have to be built in a way as to enable this piping to be taken through.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: Just like when you design flats with split unit air-conditioning systems, you have to design for it as well, including putting in the air-conditioning ledges.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: You have your own aircon ledge but, if you do CCS, then you use the CCS piping.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: In that way, that incentivises the service provider, in this instance, SP Group, to continue to offer competitive packages and to maintain the system well.
